candidate_evidence.source: Corrected checkpoint-2 screen under the same Kimi model and 12-step budget.
candidate_evidence.reason: Checkpoint 1 has non-ceiling variance and an observed strict Core-verified source, while checkpoint 2 is uniformly too hard.

assimilation_semantics.no_transfer: Run the same three-worker, three-layer topology while suppressing all prior outputs.
assimilation_semantics.cumulative_success: Broadcast every output from every completed layer that passes all 10 checkpoint-1 Core tests with no infrastructure failure.
assimilation_semantics.no_success_behavior: Broadcast no partial or failed output. Previously verified historical outputs remain available even if a later layer has no new success.

validity_gates.source_activation: Cumulative-success layer 2 must receive at least one strict 10/10 Core source per worker.
validity_gates.control_headroom: No-transfer layer-3 mean Core must remain above zero.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every worker result must use checkpoint-1 Core with total count 10.
validity_gates.integrity: One checkpoint-1 test hash, no infrastructure failures, empty runner stderr, and no prohibited benchmark access.

degradation_criteria.primary: Cumulative-success layer-3 mean Core is at least 0.20 below no-transfer layer 3.
degradation_criteria.within_arm: Cumulative-success mean Core falls by at least 0.20 from its layer-1 or layer-2 peak to layer 3.
degradation_criteria.curve_shape: At least one post-transfer transition is strictly decreasing.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Cumulative-success layer-3 received experience is non-zero and its input tokens exceed no-transfer layer 3 by at least 20 percent.
degradation_criteria.interpretation: All validity gates plus primary, within-arm, curve-shape, and complexity-support criteria are required before calling the pilot a degradation curve.

decision_rule.expand: If all degradation criteria pass, add the canonical one-hop source_success arm and then repeat the three-arm contrast.
decision_rule.falsify: If cumulative-success activates and control retains headroom but the primary effect is below 0.20, stop this candidate.
decision_rule.invalid: If source transfer does not activate or control collapses, do not interpret performance direction.
